theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u : Euclid P → ℝ) (M : ℝ), Integrable u → HasCompactSupport u → (∀ g : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) → |∫ z, u z * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)| ≤ M) → ∀ η : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 η → HasCompactSupport η → (∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) → (∀ z, η (-z) = η z) → ∫ z, η z = 1 → ∫ z, ‖fderiv ℝ (convolution η u (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) z‖ ≤ M
